We plan, install and set up a security camera system for homes and small businesses, then show you how to watch it from your phone.

What's included

  • Walk-through to plan camera spots and views

How it works

  2. We visit, plan camera spots and give you an honest quote

Questions

How many cameras do I need?

It depends on your property. Many homes and small shops are covered with 2 to 8. We recommend spots during the visit.

Can I watch from my phone?

Yes. We set up the app and make sure you can view live and recorded video.

Do you record inside my business?

Privacy rules apply to cameras that record people. We can talk through placement. For legal questions, check with a lawyer.
